tools.description: Use before beatra.speech.synthesize to make speech sound natural and human. Beatra's Smart Voice Director reads the text and the user's optional instructions, then returns a script that is ready to synthesize, written in Beatra speech markup for the target voice and model: emotion, performance, sound effects, pauses and pronunciation. absence is meaningful: no block means nothing free is waiting.

the cheapest job this card can price.

recommendation flag: endorsing a tier is the same act as ruling one out,
